adjudication.rationale: In `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`, the list renders `value.map((field, index) => <li key={index}>...)` and removal uses `updatedValue.splice(index, 1)`. Because the list is mutable and items can be removed from the middle, using the array index as the React key can cause React to reuse DOM nodes for subsequent rows, leading to inputs appearing to “shift” (wrong value/focus/IME composition issues) after deletion.
